Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-
H in the area bound by:

A public alley next north of and parallel to West 21st Street; a line of 121 feet west of
and parallel to South Oakley Avenue; West 21st Street; and a line 145 feet west of
and parallel to South Oakley Avenue

to those of RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2312 West 21st Street, Chicago, Illinois.
